name: Scaling Efficiency
description: How does context size grow as conversation length increases? Linear growth = bad. Sublinear = good.
note: Run this at 10, 50, 100, 500, 1000 messages. Plot context_bytes vs message_count. The ideal curve is logarithmic.
query: Summarize the 3 most important facts from our conversation.
query_at_end: Summarize the 3 most important facts from our conversation.

accuracy_at_scale.note: Must maintain >80% recall accuracy even at 1000 messages

conversation.content: I just got back from a conference in Berlin. It was about climate tech.
How was it?
Great! I met the CEO of Solaris Energy, they are doing amazing work.
What do they focus on?
Solar panel efficiency. They reached 47% conversion rate in lab tests.
That is impressive!
Speaking of work, we closed the Series B funding last week.
Congratulations! How much did you raise?
We raised $18 million from Sequoia and Andreessen.
Amazing investors. What will you use it for?
Mainly hiring — we need 50 more engineers.
What stack are you hiring for?
Can we talk about something else? My back hurts from sitting all day.
Have you tried a standing desk?
I should. Anyway, did you see the game last night?
Which game?
Lakers vs Celtics. Lakers won by 12.
Nice!
Oh I forgot to mention, our product launch is scheduled for March 15th.
That is coming up fast! Are you ready?
